description: This Java class defines HttpOverrideForwardedRequest, a model class in the org.mockserver.model package, used for overriding and modifying HTTP requests and responses in a mock server context. It includes static builder methods, getters, setters, and overrides for equals and hashCode.

classes.name: HttpOverrideForwardedRequest
classes.description: A model class for overriding HTTP requests and responses with methods for building, modifying, and comparing instances.
